channel.title: AI Threat Watch wire
channel.description: AI security headlines from vetted sources, refreshed every 30 minutes.

item.title: AI 'hacker' finds 4 severe bugs in popular industrial control software in under 4 hours
item.description: The Register: An AI 'hacker' reportedly found four severe bugs, one critical, in EPICS industrial control software in under four hours.

item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: MCP TypeScript SDK HTTP transports set no limit on request body size or JSON-RPC batch length, allowing memory exhaustion without credentials.

item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: Flexible GraphRAG's FalkorDB adapter has a broken escape function enabling Cypher injection that can wipe the graph from ingested documents.
